planets.name: HD 93963 A c
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 93963 A with a 3.65-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: HD 93963 A c was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around HD 93963 A. Its orbit and size follow MacDougall et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
